actions.description: Pre-cool Zone 3 by 1.5°C before tariff peak to build thermal inertia
Stagger Screw Air Compressor #1 startup by 20 mins to prevent simultaneous inrush
Soft-ramp Centrifugal Chiller #2 capped at 50% capacity during grid ramp window

reasoning: Simultaneous restart of Chiller #2 (+180 kW) and Compressor #1 (+140 kW) creates a 1241.05 kW demand spike, exceeding the 500.0 kW contract limit. Staggering compressor restart and pre-cooling Zone HVAC-3 reduces peak load to 351.8 kW.
